article.title: Canada quotations markets in everything?
article.excerpt: Canada was sarcastically known as "the Irishman's Prize", and there was talk in 1763 of swapping it for the French Caribbean island of Guadeloupe. That is from James Belich's Replenishing the Earth: The Settler Revolution and the Rise of the Anglo World, 1783-1939 .
